auto_context.card: This is an archived Japanese-language gaming live stream uploaded on July 17, 2026, by Korone (戌神ころね / Inugami Korone), a VTuber from hololive Gamers. She is playing Toilet 8, a spot-the-difference or anomaly-finding game set in a toilet environment, available on Steam, iOS, and Android. The tone is casual and energetic, typical of Korone's streams, and the session ran approximately two hours and nine minutes.
